Raus aus dem Kopf, rein in den Körper
Stark werden, ohne sich zu verbiegen

feed.title: 5 moves for when you're exhausted
feed.desc: Sanfte Karussell-Reihe: Child's Pose, Cat-Cow, liegende Drehung, Beine an die Wand, Atem.
feed.caption: "For the days when even getting out of bed felt like a workout. 5 gentle moves, no pressure. Save this for tonight 🤍"

feed.title: Shoulders that carry everything
feed.caption: "We carry the groceries, the kids, the mental load. No wonder our shoulders hurt. Try these tonight and tell me how it felt."

feed.title: Your 10-minute evening reset
feed.desc: Atem + Dehnung, passend zur Reset Routine.
feed.caption: "The movement part of my Reset Routine for Tired Days. The full routine is free, link in bio 🌙"

feed.title: 3-minute kitchen counter stretch
feed.desc: Dehnen an der Küchenarbeitsplatte, während das Wasser kocht.
feed.caption: "No time? You have 3 minutes while the kettle boils. Your kitchen counter is your new yoga studio ☕"

feed.title: Where we hold our stress: the hips
feed.caption: "Stress loves to hide in our hips. These openers feel like a sigh for your body."

feed.title: Calm your nervous system
feed.desc: Langsamer Flow, mit Atem-Hinweis 4 ein, 6 aus.
feed.caption: "When your head won't stop, slow your body down first. Breathe in for 4, out for 6."

feed.title: Strong at home, no equipment
feed.caption: "Strength is not about looking a certain way. It's about carrying your life with ease 💪"

feed.title: Wake-up flow before the house wakes up
feed.caption: "Before the noise starts: 5 minutes that belong only to you."

feed.title: Posture reset for mamas
feed.caption: "For everyone who carries little humans (or big bags) all day. Your back says thank you."

feed.title: Cosy evening mobility in your pyjamas
feed.desc: Mobilität auf dem Sofa oder im Bett.
feed.caption: "Dark evenings, warm socks, slow moves. Movement can be cosy too 🕯️"

feed.title: Moves you can do with your kids
feed.caption: "Can't find time for yourself? Take them with you. Laughter counts as cardio 😄"

feed.title: Winter rituals: breath & movement
feed.desc: Atem + 3 Bewegungen für die dunkle Zeit, Teaser fürs Gathering im Dezember.
feed.caption: "Our first Wild Hearts Gathering is coming in December. Until then, here is a little winter ritual for you ✨"

feed.title: Which move helped you most?
feed.desc: Rückblick-Karussell mit den Lieblingsübungen des Monats.
feed.caption: "A month of moving gently. Which one became your favourite? Tell me 1–5 in the comments 👇"
